Direction: Paper & ink. A warm light editorial workbench with oat-white #F5F2EB ground, warm pale stone #EAE5DB navigation and panel headers, white-cream #FCFAF6 work surfaces INCLUDING the terminal (a readable LIGHT terminal, no large dark rectangle), soft taupe #D6CFC2 separators, deep charcoal brown #292723 body text, secondary brown-grey #6B6258, and strong restrained oxblood #853C43 primary accent. Main action oxblood fill with warm white text. Task title is an elegant sturdy editorial serif, all controls and body use a highly legible modern sans, terminal uses crisp mono. 3px near-square corners, subtle precision rather than soft cards. Muted burgundy avatars. No fake paper grain or physical desk. The polished craft of an editorial manuscript review desk expressed as functional desktop software. No gradients, green accents, decorative art, or shadows around every panel.
approvalScope: User selected layout and editorial feel on 2026-09-23. Palette remains under revision.
